title: Monochrome Leather & Blunt Bangs
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight, blunt-cut hair and wind-swept strands sits in a black-and-white portrait. She wears a black leather zip jacket with a wide collar and a twisted silver hoop earring. Her expression is direct and intense. A light gray seamless backdrop, high-contrast studio lighting, and sharp shadows along the jaw. Monochrome palette of black, white, and mid-gray. Sharp and graphic, in the style of a contemporary fashion campaign.
workingNotes:
- The blunt bangs and leather collar are the key shapes.
- Add 'black and white film' to set the monochrome tone.
